disclaimer: All equations and parameters in this registry represent synthetic computational models for closed-loop control research. None are clinically validated for human neuromodulation or medical device dosing.

engine_b_phenomenological.role: Fast state-space phenomenological challenge engine (Engine B)

equations.exponential_carryover_update: x(t + dt) = exp(-dt / tau) * x(t) + (1 - exp(-dt / tau)) * x_target(u_delivered)

engine_b_phenomenological.provenance: Synthetic phenomenological state-space abstraction designed to test history-dependent carryover, habituation, and delayed sensitization under partial observability.

engine_a_mechanistic.role: Biophysical dorsal horn conductance & chloride homeostasis reference engine (Engine A)

equations.wdr_membrane_potential: C_m * dV/dt = -g_L*(V - E_L) - g_exc*(V - E_exc) - g_GABA*(V - E_GABA)

units.Cl_i: mM (valid domain [2.0, 60.0], rest ~6.5 mM in intact, ~16.0 mM in KCC2-impaired)

engine_a_mechanistic.provenance: Simplified dorsal horn gate circuit inspired by Prescott, De Koninck & Sejnowski (2006) and Doyon et al. (2016) chloride homeostasis models. Electroneutral KCC2 flux is grounded in the net chemical potential product [K]_i[Cl]_i - [K]_o[Cl]_o.
